description: In front of the hands is a green tablecloth covered with sorted piles of colorful beads, a long strand of dark-blue beads, and a tall dark cup. The left hand holds a thin tool while the right hand moves in toward the loose blue-and-green bead pile, pinches up a single bead, then shifts back toward the left hand and brings the bead to the tool as if threading it on, before the right hand returns to pick up another bead.
